user.title: Vinyl ID
user.description: Adds a Record Player that shows the song, cover and progress of the record the Vinyl ID app hears. Vinyl ID v0.12.0 by Goobis. AI was used to help develop this application.

data.url: Address of the Vinyl ID app
data.speaker: Speaker that plays your record (optional)
data.source_player: Player your turntable is plugged into (optional)

data_description.url: Leave as it is when the app runs on this Home Assistant. For the app on another machine: an address like http://192.168.1.50:8780.
data_description.speaker: The speaker or amp you listen to records on. The Record Player's volume and power buttons control it. Leave empty to only show what is playing.
data_description.source_player: The Music Assistant player whose line-in the record is on, for example an Apollo CAST. When that player is idle, Vinyl ID starts its line-in and connects the app to it, also after restarts. It never takes the player away from other music. Leave empty if the record reaches the app another way.

line_in.title: Connections
line_in.description: How the record gets to your speaker and to the app. Vinyl ID sets these up when a record starts and keeps them that way.

data.speaker_source: Your speaker's input for the record (optional)

data_description.speaker_source: The input on your speaker or amp that the record player comes in on, for example Optical or Line In. The Record Player switches your speaker to it whenever a record starts. Leave empty to switch inputs yourself.
data_description.source_name: The line-in in that player's list of sources. If the list is empty, type the name exactly as the player shows it.
data_description.listener: The speaker the Vinyl ID app created in Music Assistant, named Vinyl ID Listener unless you renamed it in the app. If it is not in the list yet, wait a minute and open this form again. It is hidden from dashboards, since it is not the player to look at. It keeps working and stays under Settings > Entities.

data_description.monitor: Only for a player that has a setting to play its line-in either directly or in sync with other rooms, direct listed first. Vinyl ID then picks direct while only that player listens, and in sync when you group other speakers onto the record.

data.url: Address of the Vinyl ID app

data_description.url: Leave as it is when the app runs on this Home Assistant. For the app on another machine: an address like http://192.168.1.50:8780.

error.cannot_connect: No Vinyl ID app answered at that address. Check that the app is started; if it runs on another machine, use an address like http://192.168.1.50:8780.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Vinyl ID is already set up.
